findings.title: Deployments with a base64 clientKey fail every operation after upgrading stack
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The base64 clientKey break comes from the exact 0.31 pin and is supported by the changeset and action comment; the mitigations are concrete.

findings.title: Native entry passes authStrategy under the pre-0.31 `strategy` key
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Native newClient still passes `strategy` while the PR renames the WASM field to authStrategy and calls `strategy` a deprecated alias, so native auth depends on an unverified alias; passing authStrategy is an easy fix.

findings.title: Callers branching on error.code see different values
findings.label: valid
findings.note: handleError and getErrorCode now drop codes isProtectErrorCode rejects, a real behaviour change from this PR; checking the guard set against 0.31's thrown codes is a sensible verification.
